Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Michael Cervantes (E025), contractor, Analyst role.
Request: admin access to Source Code.

Policy:
- Contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.
- Security training: basic (no advanced training).
- So maximum for this contractor is read.

Requested level: admin. Above maximum. Grant maximum = read.

Also never grant more than requested. Read is below admin, fine.

Decision: read.
